title: PHP Beginner Mock Test 3
description: Comprehensive 50-minute mock examination for PHP at beginner level.

questions.prompt: Which code-review warning about strict types is valid?

options.text: it does not validate HTTP input automatically

questions.explanation: it does not validate HTTP input automatically. Confirm with linting, focused tests, and observable failure handling.
